name: indicatorSysid
label: Indicator
description: Indicator to display

name: breakdowns
label: Breakdowns

properties.name: hierarchy_id
properties.label: hierarchy id
properties.description: hierarchy id to add when its optionally selected for a breakdown. Supported only for data snapshot indicators.

description: Breakdown to apply to the indicator. No breakdowns are applied by default

name: aggregate
label: Aggregate
description: A default time aggregate to apply to the indicator. When unspecified, no aggregates are applied

name: domain
label: Domain
description: Select a specific domain to view scores for

name: scoreDate
label: Score date
description: Date ('YYYY-MM-DD') for which indicator scores display. Default is the last date for which scores are available

name: scoreTime
label: Score time
description: Time ('hh:mm:ss') in UTC for which indicator scores display. Default is the last time for which scores are available

name: startDateProp
label: Date range: Start date
description: Start Date ('YYYY-MM-DD') of the date range. Default is the first date for which scores are available

name: endDateProp
label: Date range: End date
description: End Date ('YYYY-MM-DD') of the date range. Default is the last date for which scores are available

name: calendarInfo
label: Calendar info
description: Calendar group and aggregation period information to view scores and data viz chart for. Supported only for data snapshot indicators. For example, `{ calendarGroup: 'standard', aggregationPeriod: '20' }`, where `calendarGroup` is the calendar to use and `aggregationPeriod` is the aggregation period to use. By default, no calendar or aggregation period is applied

name: kpiDetailsView
label: KPI Details View
description: Choose the type of view to be displayed when KPI Details opens

name: showRecordsView
label: Show records view
description: Enable if Records view needs to be shown when KPI Details opens

name: recordsListView
label: Records List View
description: Choose the list view for displaying records in KPI Details

name: statisticsOrientation
label: Statistics Orientation
description: Select whether to list the statistics horizontally or vertically. Show Statistics in the Chart Options must be enabled.

name: showHorizontalStatisticOrientation
label: Show statistics horizontally
description: Show statistics in a horizontal row instead of a vertical list

name: showPartialScores
label: Show partial scores
description: When true, shows scores corresponding to the incomplete periods for data snapshot indicators.

name: indicatorProperties
label: Indicator Properties
description: Properties needed for various renderings and calculations on KPI Details page. Supported only for data snapshot indicators.

name: showRecordQuickEdit
label: Enable record quick-view
description: Shows a Preview button for viewing or editing record details in KPI Details, depending on user access

name: showCompareRecords
label: Enable records comparison
description: Show button for toggling the Compare Records view on KPI Details

name: showRealTime
label: Enable real time update
description: Show real-time scores in KPI Details by default. Requires real-time scores to be enabled on the indicator. The `Score date` and `Aggregate` properties override this property

name: showTargetBadge
label: Enable target status badge
description: Show target status badge on the score summary in KPI Details.

name: user
label: User
description: The user who is currently logged in and viewing KPI Details

name: panel
label: Side panel
description: Select a specific panel to be opened by default when KPI Details opens

name: origin
label: Origin
description: Specifies the origin of the KPI Details component. Used for analytics and tracking purposes.
